feedback.tipDeveloping: Focus on smooth breathing and steady laps — consistency will pull pace down over time.
feedback.tipStrokeVariety: {stroke} was {percent}% of today's swim. Mixing strokes can balance muscles and keep training fresh.

feedback.tipDefault2: Trust the routine — steady sessions like this add up faster than you think.
